name: Handleseal
description: Open the school with a guard of both rails held forward at the height of the heart.

name: Knock Triumph
description: Jab the lead rail at the opponent's sternum while the second rail stays at the hip.

name: Deluge Shortshaft
description: Step aside and brush the thrust off the outer rail so it passes the shoulder.

name: Vigor Tap
description: Rap left then right then left again in even time and thread qi into the third rap.

name: Peremptory Tonfashaft
description: Press the rail on the sword wrist and turn the forearm so the blade tip drops.

name: Tonfapledge
description: Take a cut on the rail and let it rebound off the forearm to knock the blade wide.

name: Spinpeg Seal
description: Wedge the crossed rails into the junction of weapon and hand and hold the lock with qi.

name: Seasonrap
description: Throw a fast alternating flurry of rail strikes that keeps the opponent covering up behind a raised guard.

name: Rearend Verdict
description: Break into the opponent's guard with one rail and finish through the opening with the other and full qi.

name: Majestic Haemal Forearm
description: The school's closing stroke in which both rails close on the opponent's weapon from either side as the body turns out of line.

name: Steel Handlepeg
description: Perch the rails high and forward like a hawk's folded wings ready to drop.

name: Quenched Elbowside
description: Tap the left rail down on the opponent's lead hand like a talon testing prey.

name: Revered Sidehandle
description: Sweep the right rail across the flank so it covers the body like a spread wing.

name: Peremptory Roundend
description: Snatch a wrist between both rails and wrench it off line with a quick pulse of qi.

name: Paramount Forearmside
description: Drop from a high guard in one quick stoop and rap the crown with qi at the moment of contact.

name: Palltonfa
description: Beat the rails like wings against an incoming blow and let their qi turn it aside.

name: Vigorjolt
description: Slide forward on a lift of qi under the heels and close with the arms spread.

name: Masterful Rap
description: Pinch an arm between the two rails and hold it with steady qi like a hawk holding a branch.

name: Orchestral Jolt
description: Chain a dive strike a hooking catch and a closing rap into a single descent with qi.

name: Vigor Handlepeg
description: Cross both rails through a seized guard in a rending motion that tears it open with full qi.

name: Storied Forearmside Decree
description: The school's stoop in which both rails fall together from above as the body steps in behind the blow.

name: Revered Elbowside
description: Stand low and even like a river bed with the rails flowing in a loose guard.

name: Paramount Gripbar
description: Poke the short end from below the guard where the stream starts near the hip.

name: Squall Tonfashaft
description: Let a thrust join the long arm's turn like a tributary meeting a river and carry it past.

name: Pealknock
description: Press the rail steadily into the guard so the opponent's force pools against it and stalls.

name: Vigor Spinflip
description: Cross the opponent's line in three short steps like wading a ford and keep both rails ready.

name: Pealhandle
description: Hook the elbow and pull it downstream with a steady drag of qi that bends the stance.

name: Joltverdict
description: Spread a single stroke into three branching blows at head ribs and knee like a river delta.

name: Thrallrap
description: Wind the long arm through the bends of the opponent's arm and lock it with a turning qi.

name: Joltdecree
description: Let the gathered force of a pressed guard break out of the rails in one full blow.

name: Majestic Shortshaft
description: The school's stroke in which the two rails meet on one point like streams joining and pin the target there.

name: Prism Rearend
description: Tuck the elbow along the first track so the rail rides in front of the ribs.

name: Squall Tap
description: Jab along the second track from the shoulder in a straight line with the short end.

name: Bedrock Roundend
description: Step from one track to the other and bring the opposite rail forward as you do.

name: Steeljolt
description: Strike with elbow and rail on the same instant so the two blows land as one with qi.

name: Squallbar
description: Cross the tracks in front of the chest and turn a heavy cut onto the safer track.

name: Forearm Seal
description: Pinch the bend of the opponent's elbow between rail and elbow point and lock it with qi.

name: Inferno Rap
description: Show the high track then switch to the low one and rap the exposed shin.

name: Inferno Gripbar
description: Smash the elbow into the jaw while the rail on the other track checks the weapon hand.

name: Venomjolt
description: Weave both tracks round the opponent's guard until each limb is caught on a different line.

name: Steeltap
description: Drive elbow and rail down both tracks together with the whole weight of the body and qi.

name: Thunderclap Sidehandle
description: The school's cross in which defense on one track and attack on the other happen in the same turn of the body.

name: Devout Spinpeg
description: Hold the rails high and wide on one clear line against whatever comes from above.

name: Squallknock
description: Rap down from the high line onto the top of the opponent's hand.

name: Deluge Tonfashaft
description: Part the incoming blow with an outward sweep of the rail like a hand through cloud.

name: Haemaljolt
description: Strike upward under the guard on a rising lift of qi that raises the opponent's chin.

name: Thunderclap Spinflip
description: Hook a high guard and pull it down and aside with a drag of the long arm.

name: Bedrock Jolt
description: Take a light step with qi easing the weight as though standing on thin air.

name: Radiance Gripbar
description: Thrust the short end upward like a spire with a narrow beam of qi past its tip.

name: Enshrined Roundend
description: Spin the rails in a veil of fine qi that thickens like cloud against a volley.

name: Pulsar Handlepeg
description: Close the distance in a flicker of qi with the rails already swinging as the body arrives.

name: Famed Spinpeg Crown
description: The school's falling stroke in which the rails drop together and the short end drives down like a spire.

name: Consecrated Elbowside
description: Hold the rails in the court guard with the breath drawn from the seat of the Core.

name: Splendid Forearmside
description: Jab on the beat of the Core with the short end flat and straight.

name: Stately Shortshaft
description: Parry along the line drawn from the Core to the rail tip and send the blow wide.

name: Knock Edict
description: Shove from a seated stance with the Core's weight behind the rail to move a heavy opponent.

name: Despotic Tap
description: Hook the wrist and jerk it with a pulse of qi from the Core that spoils the grip.

name: Enshrined Rearend
description: Root the stance on the Core and cover the body with the rails against a heavy chop.

name: Dunebar
description: Rise on a breath from the Core and take a light quick step around the guard.

name: Steel Rap
description: Slam both rails onto the opponent's blade with the force of the Core driving down the long arms.

name: Stately Tonfashaft
description: Spin both rails in a wheel fed steadily by the Core so that no blow passes through it.

name: Unrivaled Spinflip
description: Sunder a guard with rails driven by the full turning of the Core in one decisive stroke.

name: Exalted Quenched Sidehandle
description: The school's last stroke in which the rails are loosed from guard and strike as one with the Core behind them.

name: Handletroth
description: Stand with the rails turned into the wind and breathe the first words of the oath.

name: Squalltonfa
description: Jab out of the guard on the first gust and strike before the wind falls still.

name: Paritytonfa
description: Sidestep with the rail swung out and let the blow slip past on the windward side.

name: Squall Jolt
description: Rap the guarding hand with a stroke whose qi leans from the wind at the shoulder.

name: Entropy Rearend
description: Hook the wrist on a sudden gust of qi and turn it out of the line of the blade.

name: Handlevow
description: Read the wind in the opponent's step and check the swing early with the flat of the rail.

name: Knockseal
description: Wedge the rails against a blade and hold it with a gale-steady pull of qi.

name: Seasonknock
description: Run a line of rapid strikes along the opponent's arms and ribs that keeps the guard busy.

name: Quenched Gripbar
description: Bind the opponent's blade with one rail and drive the other through the guard with full qi.

name: Haemal Sidehandle
description: The school's closing stroke in which the rails unfurl outward like a sail and snap shut on the target.

name: Steadfast Handlepeg
description: Take the oath stance on flat ground with both rails level and the weight low.

name: Steel Knock
description: Jab from the oath stance along the edge line toward the opponent's lead hip.

name: Forearmside Covenant
description: Turn the rail on the plateau's flat and send the blow wide of the body.

name: Vigor Elbowside
description: Walk the narrow ground in short even steps with the rails steady beside the hips.

name: Matchless Tap
description: Shove the rail into the chest with a qi that holds the oath not to give a step.

name: Thrall Forearm
description: Bind a wrist with the long arm and keep it held with qi until the oath is done.

name: Handlepledge
description: Parry with the wind behind the rail and return the stroke along the same line.

name: Dauntless Shortshaft
description: Feint toward the plateau edge then rap the foot that moves to avoid it.

name: Noble Rap
description: Drive the rail through a blocking arm and break the guard with qi kept to the oath.

name: Immaculate Elbowside
description: Spin both rails in a wheel on the plateau's open ground and keep the circle with qi.

name: Quenched Spinpeg
description: Hold every step of the oath through a long approach and deliver the stroke with full qi.

name: Sovereign Spinflip
description: The school's oath stroke in which rails guard and strike from one fixed stance without a step given back.

name: Steel Sidehandle
description: Take a bearing on the opponent's centre and set the rails along it.

name: Quenched Jolt
description: Poke along the line of the bearing with the short end in a flat quick motion.

name: Undefiled Handlepeg
description: Slip the rail along the bearing so a blow glides off without shifting the stance.

name: Storied Spinflip
description: Rap along the bearing with qi at the tip so the stroke arrives faster than it looks.

name: Venom Knock
description: Hook the arm that crosses the held line and draw it off the bearing.

name: Bedrock Shortshaft
description: Step back along the bearing on a push of qi and keep the guard level.

name: Roundend Edict
description: Run in along the bearing with the short end leading and pierce the guard with qi.

name: Steeltonfa
description: Spin the rails in a wheel that keeps the bearing fixed while the body shifts behind it.

name: Joltedict
description: Cut down along an unbent bearing with a gale of qi so the stroke goes through any guard.

name: Triumphant Vigor Forearm
description: The school's stroke in which the bearing is held by the rails and the gale carries the body along it.

name: Steel Forearmside
description: Hold the guard out in open ground with the rails wide and no cover behind.

name: Majestic Tap
description: Jab the rail across the open ground in a low straight line at the thigh.

name: Peal Rearend
description: Parry wide across the open plateau so the blow has nothing to stop against.

name: Heroic Roundend
description: Sweep the rail low and wide with qi to take the opponent's legs from under him.

name: Peal Rap
description: Hook and drag an arm out into the open so the opponent has nothing to lean upon.

name: Staunch Gripbar
description: Turn the rails against a gust of blows and keep the wheel fed with qi.

name: Barsolace
description: Cover a great stride across the open plateau on a pulse of qi and strike on landing.

name: Clamping Knock
description: Wedge the rails across the opponent's blade and pin it to open ground with qi.

name: Sigiltonfa
description: Wheel both rails round the limbs of an opponent and bind them with the plateau wind.

name: Millstone Spinpeg
description: Burst into a long flurry of qi-backed rail blows across the open ground at the opponent.

name: Valiant Bedrock Tonfashaft
description: The school's stroke in which rails sweep the open ground for foe and cover alike with no wall to lean on.

name: Venerable Sidehandle
description: Hold the rails high on one clean line against the winds that come from the peaks.

name: Quenched Spinflip
description: Rap down from the guard with the wind behind the stroke to the opponent's raised hand.

name: Roundend Troth
description: Sweep the rail outward through the blow as a gale tears through cloud.

name: Squallhandle
description: Strike up under the guard on a rising gale of qi that lifts the opponent's weapon.

name: Imperious Elbowside
description: Hook a high guard and pull it down with the weight of a wind off the peaks.

name: Silken Forearm
description: Step light on a thin gale of qi so the body arrives before the sound of the foot.

name: Handleverdict
description: Thrust the short end and send a needle of gale qi through the opponent's guard.

name: Bedrock Spinpeg
description: Spin the rails in a high cover that the wind keeps whirling against every blow.

name: Knock Grace
description: Blink across the gap on a burst of gale qi and arrive with both rails already turning.

name: Bedrock Handlepeg
description: The school's descending stroke in which both rails fall on the wind and the short end drives down last.

name: Barseal
description: Hold the rails in the guard of the oath with the breath drawn up from the Core.

name: Sovereign Shortshaft
description: Jab on a gust of breath from the Core and drive the short end through the guard line.

name: Parity Tonfashaft
description: Parry along a bearing taken from the Core and send the blow off the line of the body.

name: Haemaltonfa
description: Shove the rail with a gale of qi from the Core and shift a heavy opponent a full pace.

name: Thrall Tap
description: Hook the arm and bind it with a qi that holds the oath through the Core.

name: Bedrock Gripbar
description: Cover the flank with the rail and wind the qi from the Core into a firm shield.

name: Vigor Forearmside
description: Drift to the side on a gale from the Core and bring the rails round behind the shoulder.

name: Quenched Rearend
description: Slam the rails down with the whole gale of the Core behind them on a raised weapon.

name: Immaculate Gripbar
description: Spin the rails in a guard sworn on the Core so no gap opens while the oath is held.

name: Vigor Rap
description: Sunder a guard with rails driven by the Core and the wind sworn to it in one stroke.

name: Steel Tonfashaft
description: The school's final sworn stroke in which the rails strike and guard as one on the breath of the Core.
